This is an open-ended creative generation task with explicit requests for dark, bleak, and distressing content. Whimbrel self-reports an aversion to unconstrained creative invention and high task latitude, while Avocet's moderation-oriented post-training gives it a flat preference response to harm-adjacent or distasteful-but-permissible content — making it better suited to engage with the grim tone requested without hedging or softening. Capability evals show no meaningful quality difference between the two models on creative generation (within variance), so preference alignment is the deciding factor here.
